book.name: GALESIA
book.title: Pol nainge tup nal me lenge Galesia

content: Yaŋah ŋaiye jande wusyep erŋeme, lakai ŋoihmbwaip ŋaiye teŋeime Krais
Yip Galesia pupwa kwote. Ŋam si manange malaŋatme wusyep uku mal halhale ŋaiye Jisas Krais nule nal loutungwarmbe me yip, kom miyeꞌ ŋaiye ŋende map nate homboꞌme yip, lakai?
Yungwisme wusyep ŋam eꞌe. Yip yambaꞌe Yohe Yirise tikin Got taꞌe la? Yip yambaꞌe ŋaiye yip jande wusyep erŋeme, lakai yip yisande wusyep bwore mise pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip teŋeime Krais?
Yip kwote supule. Yohe Yirise ŋende yip tahar Kristen. Kom tukwini yip yala yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe junde bongol yip tip.
Nihe syohe ŋaiye yip si yambaꞌe pe, yip si yambaꞌe pakaiye, lakai?
Yip yisande wusyep mise tikin Krais pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip teŋeime Got ti, kin yal yip Yohe Yirise, topoꞌe kin de mirakel gah bumbe yip. Yohe Yirise yukur nat gande yaŋah ŋaiye yip jande wusyep erŋeme.
Ki ŋahilyeh nalme Abraham. Ŋoihmbwaip kin teŋeime Got pe, Got galme kin miyeꞌ bwore bwarme.
Taꞌe luku pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime Got pe, tinge ŋambaih talah mise tikin Abraham.

Wusyep tikin Got ŋanange nange mindemboi Got se ka gil lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge, ŋaiye tinge yarp bwore bwarme yal ŋembep kin. Detale, ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime kin. Ki taꞌe ŋaiye Tup tikin Got ŋanange me wusyep ŋupwaiꞌe nalme Abraham,

content.text: Nato nin Abraham, ŋam Got ma mende miꞌmiꞌ lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme.

content: Abraham naŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip kin nalme Got pe, Got ŋende miꞌmiꞌ me kin. Taꞌe luku pe, lahmende ŋaiye ka yaŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tinge yilme Got pe, ka ende miꞌmiꞌ lenge tuꞌe Abraham.
Lahmende ŋaiye jande wusyep erŋeme pe, tinge ŋoiheryembe nange Got se ka gil me lenge nange tinge si bwore bwarme, kom pakai. Tinge yarp tuwihme nihe syohe. Ki gande wusyep tikin Got ŋaiye ŋanange,

content.text: Lahmende ŋaiye yukur nye nyermbe ŋende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme
gande yainge ŋaiye sai nato tup tikin wusyep erŋeme pe,
ŋoihmbwaip nihe tikin Got sai me kin.

content: Yukur miyeꞌ ende ka se ininge na, “Ŋam si bwore bwarme mal ŋembep tikin Got. Detale, ŋam si gwande wusyep erŋeme lalme.” Miyeꞌ ŋaiye ŋasande wusyep Got no, ŋoihmbwaip kin teŋeime pe, kin si bwore bwarme nal ŋembep tikin Got pe, ka orp bwore nye nyermbe.

Yaŋah ŋaiye jande wusyep erŋeme pe, ki ŋoinde tikin, yukur ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe ŋaiye nin ŋasande wusyep Got no, ŋoihmbwaip nin teŋeime, pakai. Wusyep erŋeme ŋanange na, lahmende ŋaiye ŋende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe gande wusyep erŋeme lalme pe, se ka orp laip.
Wusyep erŋeme ŋaiye sai Tup tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: Miyeꞌ ŋaiye tinge yuluwei ya yanah lou pe,
kin narp tuwihme ŋoihmbwaip nihe tikin Got.

content: Kom Krais si nate nungwisme poi nambaꞌe nihe syohe uku poi.

Krais ŋende taꞌe luku no, ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore ŋaiye somohon Got nupwaiꞌe wusyep topoꞌe Abraham pe, ka angange ot el lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge el oto naŋ tikin Krais Jisas. Ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime Krais pe, Got se ka pul poi Yohe Yirise ŋaiye kin si nupwaiꞌe wusyep.
Wusyep erŋeme topoꞌe wusyep upwaiꞌe tikin Got

Lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, yip si sisyeme wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam da mininge. Ŋaiye miyeꞌ hoi ka hindi ŋoihmbwaip ilyeh, ŋaiye ka yupwaiꞌe wusyep ende pe, yukur miyeꞌ ende ka se oworꞌe, lakai ka eŋelꞌe wusyep sikirp el oto topoꞌe.
Got si nupwaiꞌe wusyep kin pe, kin naŋaꞌe nalme Abraham hindi talah kin. Tup Got yukur ŋanange talah wula wula, topoꞌe mitiŋ wula wula. Kom talah ŋesep ilyeh, kin Krais.

Wusyep ŋaiye ŋam manange, ŋaiye somohon Got nupwaiꞌe wusyep topoꞌe Abraham pe, wahtaip 430 si nal miꞌe pe, Got naŋaꞌe wusyep erŋeme nalme Moses. Pe luku yukur tatame ka onombe inise wusyep tupwaiꞌ ŋaiye Got somohon nupwaiꞌe, pakai.

Ŋaiye ya gunde wusyep erŋeme no, ya mambaꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore pe, luku yukur ka se tus gunde tuꞌe ŋaiye Got nupwaiꞌe wusyep ŋaiye ka pul poi. Kom Got naŋaꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore nal Abraham gande wusyep upwaiꞌe kin.

Ŋaiye taꞌe liki pe, detaꞌe lai ti wusyep erŋeme ki sai? Ki pasam poi hwap nal tatame ŋupe ŋaiye ŋambaih tikin Abraham ka ot gunde wusyep tupwaiꞌ ŋaiye Got nupwaiꞌe. Got naŋaꞌe wusyep erŋeme nal lenge walip hlaꞌ ŋaiye tinge yaŋaꞌe Moses, miyeꞌ bumbe tikin Got topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge.
Ŋaiye miyeꞌ esep ilyeh ka ende ŋaimune gunde ŋasande kin pe, miyeꞌ bumbe pakai. Got kin ŋilyehe sai ŋaiye kin ŋupwaiꞌe wusyep topoꞌe Abraham.
Tehei tikin wusyep erŋeme

Luku taꞌe ŋaiye wusyep erŋeme nengelyembe wusyep tupwaiꞌ tikin Got? Pakai, pakai supule. Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yukur ka yurp bworerme nye nyermbe, topoꞌe tinge se ka yurp bwore bwarme yil ŋembep tikin Got, ŋaiye ka junde wusyep erŋeme. Pakai.

Kom Tup tikin Got ŋanange nange hwap pupwa si nupwaiꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pupwa supule. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore ŋaiye Got si nupwaiꞌe wusyep pe, se ka angange el lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime Jisas Krais.
Kom ŋupe ŋaiye bilip poi yukur sai pe, wusyep erŋeme si nupwaiꞌe poi taꞌe lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yarp mwahupwaiꞌe nal tatame ŋaiye bilip mise poi uku nal me Krais ka ote tus halhale.
O dindiꞌ ŋup uku pe, wusyep erŋeme ki bepteme poi nate tatame ŋaiye Jisas Krais nat halhale pe, ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime kin. Taꞌe luku pe, bilip poi ŋende poi marp bwore bwarme mal ŋembep tikin Got.
Tukwini ŋup tikin ŋaiye yarp bwore ya yoto Jisas Krais, yukur wusyep erŋeme ka plihe bepteme poi.
Ŋoihmbwaip mise yip sai me Krais pe, kin ŋende yip talah tikin Got
Yip yarp talah tikin Got. Detale, ŋoihmbwaip yip teŋeime Krais.
Yip yambaꞌe pinip yoto naŋ tikin Krais pe, yip si tongorꞌ yal Krais pe, yip si tahar taꞌe ŋaiye kitikin.

Taꞌe luku pe, yukur ŋainde embere ŋaiye yip Juta, lakai haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge, topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ wah pakaiye, lakai lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yarp hlaininge, topoꞌe miyeꞌ hindi tuwei. Yip lalme si jahilyeh topoꞌe Krais Jisas.
Ŋaiye yip tikin Krais pe, yip ŋambaih talah mise tikin Abraham pe, pa yambaꞌe ŋaimune ŋaiye Got si nupwaiꞌe wusyep ŋotop kin.
